source_description_html:
Tour Master Elite Motorcycle Cover

Protect your investment with the Tour Master Elite Motorcycle Cover.

Features:

  • Made from high quality 300 Denier Carbolex®
  • 100% waterproof
  • Double stitched and taped seams
  • Fully vented
  • Aluminized heat panels help protect the cover from the hottest parts of the bike
  • Elasticized bottom with 1” grommets can accommodate a locking device
  • Soft windshield and tail section protector fabric
  • Stuff bag included
  • Fits most bikes

Sizes:

  • MD - Sport/Standard: Fits 500cc to 1100cc Standards without windscreen or accessories, Sportsbikes 
  • LG - Sport/Standard: Fits Sportbikes and Standards up to 1300cc with fairings and saddlebags
  • XL - Touring: Fits Tourings with fairings and luggage
  • 2XL - Touring/Full Dress; Fits large Tourings up to 1800cc with full dress accessories
